create_env_info_observer: create an EnvInfoObserver instance to collect scalar metrics from a dm_env environment's get_info method
accumulate_metrics_from_env: accumulate scalar values from an environment's get_info output into the observer's internal metrics dictionary
observe_first_initial_state: call observe_first to reset metrics and record the initial state of a dm_env environment
observe_environment_step: call observe to record one environment step and accumulate metrics from the environment's info
get_collected_metrics: call get_metrics to retrieve the accumulated scalar metrics dictionary for the current episode
